written: 2026-11-08, before any scoring against Qwen or the PI answers (only raw word counts of the CoT text had been seen)
flags: IGNORECASE; every regex is wrapped in word boundaries by the matcher

negation.rule: applied to the text immediately before a match; a negated match is recorded as negated_<class> and is NOT counted as a positive mention

surface.snow_ice: \b(?:icy|ice|black ice|slippery|slush|snow-?covered|snowy road|snow on the road|packed snow|frozen)\b

period_of_day_rule: derived, no extra regex: night = illumination.night or illumination.dark; twilight = illumination.twilight; day = illumination.day; mixed hits give a multi-value string
secondary_source: VQA answers in _s2build-copy-20260919/alpamayo/records.parquet (task=vqa), one random question per clip; reported separately, not part of the weak label
